business_problem: Schaeffler needed to modernize data management and unlock intelligence across diverse IT/OT systems, using generative AI. This enables advanced factory reporting and troubleshooting to boost uptime, quality, productivity, and yields.
solution_summary: Schaeffler built this solution on Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing. Schaeffler needed to modernize data management and unlock intelligence across diverse IT/OT systems, using generative AI. This enables advanced factory reporting and troubleshooting to boost uptime, quality, productivity, and yields. Azure AI provides managed AI services used to automate classification, recommendations, or decision support. Microsoft Fabric unifies lake, warehouse, and analytics workloads on a governed data foundation. Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing provides an industry cloud foundation tying manufacturing data, AI, and business applications together. The global manufacturing leader implemented data solutions in Microsoft Fabric and an agent in Azure AI, part of Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing. Schaeffler collaborated with Avanade to pilot data solutions in Microsoft Fabric and an agent in Azure AI , part of Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing.
